targets.rawSql: SELECT dns_query AS domain, count() AS query_count, countDistinct(src_ip) AS unique_sources, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM soc.suricata_dns WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 YEAR AND (dns_query LIKE '%.xyz' OR dns_query LIKE '%.top' OR dns_query LIKE '%.tk') GROUP BY dns_query ORDER BY query_count DESC

SELECT url, hostname, src_ip, dest_ip, http_method, status_code, timestamp FROM soc.suricata_http WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 YEAR AND (url LIKE '%.exe' OR url LIKE '%.dll' OR url LIKE '%.ps1') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, alert_signature, timestamp FROM soc.suricata_alerts WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 YEAR AND dest_port NOT IN (80, 443, 8080, 22, 53) AND event_type = 'alert' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
